quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on the challenges of pursuing an NBA dream
quotes.excerpt: This journey has been beyond my wildest dreams
quotes.quote: I talked about the idea of finding a dream and pursuing that and what goes into pursuing a dream. I had dreams to play at Duke, obviously the NBA. This journey has been beyond my wildest dreams and I am pinching myself every day that I am at Duke with Coach K, I am pinching myself every day I am in an NBA locker room, I am pinching myself now every day that I get to coach the Lakers.

quotes.speaker: Dr. Jamie Soltis
quotes.summary_phrase: Dr. Jamie Soltis on the importance of failing forward in life
quotes.excerpt: Life is all about failing forward
quotes.quote: Honestly, schools teach you failure is not good. You get the bad grade, you do this or that, but really life is all about failing forward and the true mark of a man isn't getting knocked down because we are all going to get knocked down, it's getting up and continuing to move forward towards your dream.
